0.question: D acu-t Podacium u amek i tebded?
0.answer: Podacium d tansa tamezdayt i yesdukklen aselmed s srid, ulzuz n yisenfaren ililelliyen d yifecka n tusna n tnezzut. Inelmaden ṭṭfen timsirin u ttwawellhen s yiselkinen, imselkimen afen isenfaren s uḥraz n uxellas, ma d tkebbaniyin sledent isefta u rent imusnawen — akk deg yiwen n unagraw.

1.question: Amek i tebded tensa s kraḍt n tgejda?
1.answer: Podacium tesɛa kraḍt n tgejda yettwaseddren: Learn (timsirin s yiselkinen yettwasenqden), Hub (ulzuz n umahil ililelli s PodaPoints mebla tiwsiyin), d BI (tifelwin n uskasi d tesleḍt n yisefta). Asfurret d tmusni tteddun gar tgejda akken aselmed ad iṣeḥḥi amaɣnu-inek ililelli.

2.question: Ma tella Podacium s Taqbaylit, Taɛrabt, Tafransist d Taglizit?
2.answer: Ih. Tansa Podacium tella s Taglizit, Tafransist, Taɛrabt d Taqbaylit. Tzemreḍ ad tbeddleḍ tutlayt melmi tebɣiḍ, yerna agbur, udem d tallelt ttwaseddren s tarrayt tameɣtut.

3.question: Anwa i yezmren ad yaf lfayda deg Podacium?
3.answer: Inelmaden d yimusnawen yebɣan ad nerneen deg tmusni, imselkimen ililelliyen yettnadin ɣef yisenfaren, tikbbaniyin yeḥwaǧen izemran d tesleḍt n yisefta — akk afen azal ameqran deg Podacium.

4.question: Eɛni ḥwaǧeɣ timusniwin titiknikiyin uqbel ad bduɣ?
4.answer: Xati akk. Podacium tettwaglem i yal aswir. Imaynuten zemren ad bdun s tmesras tizmimin, ma d isemrasen udmawanen ad k-ɛiwnen ad tafeḍ abrid iwatan i yiswiyen-inek.

5.question: Amek i tesxeddim tarrayt n yisemrasen?
5.answer: Anagraw yesselḍ amezruy n ulmad-inek, iswiyen n tmahilt d yirmuden-inek ɣef tensa iwakken ad d-yerr timsirin, isenfaren d yifecka n BI iwatan i usnerni-inek.

6.question: Zemreɣ ad seqdceɣ Podacium ɣef tilifun?
6.answer: Ih. Podacium temcabi d akk wallalen am tilifunat d tfelwin. Tzemreḍ ad teɣreḍ timsirin, ad twaliḍ isenfaren d tfelwin n BI seg yal allal. Asnas n tilifun yettwaglam tura iwakken ad yili deg uselkem.

0.question: Acḥal tewwa ssuma n Podacium?
0.answer: Podacium tefka anekcum amezwaru baṭel s tezmert n usali. Ssuma n tmesras tebda seg 500 DA, ijtihadat n Learn seg 1,500 DA deg waggur, ma d BI Pro seg 3,000 DA deg waggur. Ulzuz Hub yesseqdac PodaPoints mebla tiwsiyin ɣef tidrimt-inek. Ahilen n useggas ssenqasen alamma d 25%.

1.question: Anta tarrayin n uxxalas i tettqabalem?
1.answer: Nettqabal akk tikarḍiwin tidzayriyin n lbanka (CIB / Dahabia), tikarḍiwin tigraɣlanin (Visa, Mastercard), d tarrayin n uxxalas s tilifun. Tikebbaniyin timeqranin zemrent ad xelsent s uceggeɛ n lbanka neɣ s tfakturt.

2.question: Yella ukayad baṭel?
2.answer: Ih. Iseqdacen imaynuten ṭṭfen 14 n wussan n ukayad baṭel s unekcum ačuran ɣer akk timmad n Pro deg Learn, Hub d BI. Ulac takarḍa i yettwasutren, yerna tzemreḍ ad tsefsqeḍ melmi tebɣiḍ.

3.question: Zemreɣ ad beddleɣ neɣ ad sefsqeɣ ahil-iw melmi tebɣiḍ?
3.answer: S tidet. Tzemreḍ ad tserfdeḍ, ad tessendreḍ neɣ ad tsefsqeḍ ajerred-inek melmi tebɣiḍ seg yiɣewwaren n umiḍan. Ahilen n waggur ttbeddilen imir-imir, yerna ulac akukru ɣezzifen.

4.question: Teddum s ssuma n temnaḍt i Lezzayer d tmura n Tefriqt n Ugafa?
4.answer: Ih. Podacium tefka ssuma tudmawant s Dinar Adzayri (DZD) iṣeḥḥan i ulzuz n temnaḍt. Nettqabal CIB d Dahabia, yerna ahilen n useggas ssenqasen 25%.

0.question: Amek i yetteddu uḍfar n usfurret gar wallalen yemxalafen?
0.answer: Asfurret-inek yettwasuddes s wudem awurman deg wakud amatu gar akk wallalen-inek. Bdu tamsirt deg uselkim, kemmel deg tilifun — amkan n uvidyu, yigmaren n ukayad d tmiwa yekfan dima d imaynuten.

1.question: Zemreɣ ad awiɣ iselkinen yettwasenqden?
1.answer: Ih. Mi tfukkeḍ tamsirt neɣ abrid n ulmad, ad tafeḍ aselkin yettwasenqden i tzemreḍ ad tebḍuḍ deg LinkedIn neɣ ad ternuḍ ɣer umaɣnu-inek deg Hub.

2.question: Amek tettwaḥrez tbaḍnit n yisefta-iw deg Podacium?
2.answer: Nesseqdac taɣellist n tkebbaniyin: awelleh seg yixf ar yixf deg tuzna d usekles, asenqed imezgi n tɣellist, d usenqed unzif n unekcum. Isallen-inek d yisefta-inek dima ttwafen deg laman.

3.question: Zemreɣ ad d-ssuffɣeɣ isefta-iw?
3.answer: Ih. Tzemreḍ ad d-tessuffɣeḍ asfurret n tmesras, iselkinen, tifelwin n BI d yineqqisen s talɣiwin n CSV, PDF neɣ PNG. Isefta nniḍen ttwazdamen s CSV, Excel d JSON.

4.question: Amek i yetteddu unagraw n uxxalas deg ulzuz n yimahilen?
4.answer: Podacium tesseqdac ssuma yebnan ɣef timmad s PodaPoints. Deg umkan n twisi, tetteɣyeḍ timmad am tuzna n usenfar (200 PodaPoints). Ulac tiwsi n tensa ɣef wayen i d-trebḥeḍ — txellseḍ kan ayen tesseqdceḍ.

5.question: Eɛni tefka Podacium anekcum ɣer API i tuqqna d yifecka nniḍen?
5.answer: Ih. Podacium tefka REST API i yimneflayen d tkebbaniyin yebɣan ad qqnen timmad n tensa ɣer yibriden-nsen n umahil. Anekcum-a yella deg wahilen yettwaxellsen s tsentemt tameddant.

6.question: Amek i tettheggi Podacium taɣellist n tensa d uḥraz n yisefta?
6.answer: Taɣellist d azadur deg Podacium. Nessemres awelleh n yisefta, asenqed n tɣellist sɣur idisan uffiɣen, d usefrek n unekcum deg yimmasen n yisefta yettwaḥerzen 24/7.

0.question: Amek ara snulfuɣ amiḍan?
0.answer: Tekki ɣef 'Bdu Tura' u jerred s tansa-inek e-mail neɣ s umiḍan Google. Fren tamlilt-inek (Anelmad, Amselkim neɣ Tazeqqa) u kfu amaɣnu-inek. Tarrayt tetteddu deg ddaw n snat n tseddarin, yerna anekcum amezwaru d baṭel.

1.question: Amek ara beddleɣ awal-iw uffir?
1.answer: Tekki ɣef 'Ttuɣ awal uffir' deg usebter n unekcum, sekcem tansa-inek e-mail, ad k-d-nazen aseysey yettwaḥerzen. Aseysey-a ifecck deffir yiwet n tsaɛet i tɣellist-inek.

2.question: Zemreɣ ad sɛuɣ aṭas n temlilin deg yiwen n umiḍan?
2.answer: Ih. Tzemreḍ ad tiliḍ d anelmad, d amselkim ililelli yettnadin ɣef yisenfaren, d bab n tnezzut yettqerriɛen izemran — akk seg yiwen n umiḍan. Tafelwit-inek tettbeddil akken i k-yewata.

3.question: Amek ara ssiwleɣ i tallelt?
3.answer: Tzemreḍ ad tessiwleḍ i terbaɛt-nneɣ n tallelt s usqerdec n srid ɣef yal asebter, s e-mail ɣer support@podacium.com, neɣ deg Wammas n Tallelt. Tikebbaniyin ṭṭfent imḍebbren uzzigen s tiririt tuzwirt.

4.question: Amek ara kseɣ amiḍan-iw d yisefta-iw i lebda?
4.answer: Tzemreḍ ad tessutreḍ tukksa n umiḍan seg usebter n Yiɣewwaren ddaw n Tbaḍnit. Mi yettwasentem, isallen-inek udmawanen d usfurret ad ttwakksen deg 30 n wussan.

5.question: Eɛni tetteddu Podacium s usentem s sin n yimeḍranen (2FA)?
5.answer: Ih. Podacium tettqabal 2FA s yisnasen n usentem (Google Authenticator, Authy) d tengalin n SMS. Rmed 2FA iwakken ad trnuḍ taɣellist tameqrant i umiḍan-inek.
